column1: # SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# The closed inventory of release blockers whose publisher shipped no licence
# text at all, anywhere: not in the crate archive, and not in the upstream
# repository at the commit the crate was published from.
# A row here says only what can be checked. The crate archive that Cargo.lock
# pins declares a licence in its own manifest, and for most rows the publisher
# also states the licensing in a file in the repository at that same commit.
# Neither is a licence text and neither is treated as one. Nothing here is a
# recovered text, and no year, copyright holder or notice is inferred from the
# authors field, the git history or the repository owner's name. The notice
# reproduces the licence's own terms and says plainly that no copyright notice
# was published.
# Two evidence classes, and the notice keeps them apart:
#   * manifest only. The `license` field of the published Cargo.toml, and
#     nothing else. `dispatch` 0.2.0 is the only such package: its repository
#     has never carried a licence file, on any commit or any of its nine
#     published versions.
#   * manifest and upstream statement. The same field, plus a file the
#     copyright holder publishes at the exact commit, bound by SHA-256, whose
#     wording matches the declared field. The ten objc2-family packages share
#     one such statement.
# These rows are evidence, not accepted compliance exceptions. The inventory
# gate may reproduce them, but `tools/check-rust-notices.sh --release-ready`
# refuses every non-empty product set. The list is exhaustive and closed. A
# twelfth package needing this treatment, or any change to a pinned registry
# checksum, commit or digest, fails the gate rather than joining the list
# quietly. Shrinking it to zero is required for release; the removal conditions
# are recorded in docs/implementation-plan.md.
# Fields, tab separated:
#   source  name  version  registry_checksum  licence  manifest_declaration
#   terms_sha256  statement_repository  statement_commit  statement_path
#   statement_sha256
# A package with no upstream statement carries `-` in the last four fields.
